name: Nux-vomica + Black Pepper + Long Pepper
indication_description:
This is indicated in-
  • Rheumatoid arthritis
  • Osteoarthritis
  • Sexual debility
  • Nervous debility
  • Numbness
  • Sciatica
  • Paralysis & Facial Paralysis
pharmacology_description: This is a unique unani medicine, prepared with of Nux-vomica (Strychnos nux-vomica), Black Pepper (Piper nigrum), Long Pepper (Piper longum) and other effective natural ingredients. It is very effective in nervous debility, rheumatism, numbness, paralysis, facial paralysis and sexual debility. This is also helps to relieve tremor and sciatica.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) 1-2 time(s) daily after meal or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in the therapeutic dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
